deviation: The card is an NVIDIA L4 (sm_89, 23 GB), not the planned A4500 (sm_86): B = 20 (exp19's shape) passed the memory probe (2.4 GiB free at peak), so every cell uses exp19's exact batch pairs; the REAL FP8 path exists, so exp19's FP8Linear (W8A8REAL) runs as the engine check and as REAL cells. EMU stays the factorial's single FP8 backend, as frozen.

The L4 is not the iteration-4 card type (RTX 2000 Ada): cuBLASLt picks other kernels, so byte identity with exp19 is reported (REAL twins 0.76) and the EMU label-agreement criteria are applied to REAL as well (pre-stated in the plan for another sm_89 SKU).

One model load per process: the bf16 decoder linears are kept on the CPU and each family (W16, W8, REAL) is installed from them in 6-16 s, instead of reloading the checkpoint per family. Numerics are those of the plan's families.

Block order: Stage D REAL engine check (T2 W1-W3) -> B1 (W8A8, W8A16; T2 first, holding the EMU gate) -> B2 (W16A16, W16A8) -> B3 dither -> B4 REAL cells; the mechanism readouts run after generation in one pass per precision, because the teacher-forced KL needs the W16A16 TWIN tokens of every slot.

With B = 20 the exp19 pairs are kept: TWIN rides with PN_a0.5 and PN_a1 with PN_a2 (extra PN_a0.5 rows at no cost); dropping 'PN_a1 under the middle precisions' would save no time and is not part of the drop rule. Unit-cross batches pair PNF_a2 with PNF_a1 (PN_a1 seeds at the ban-free unit). Dither batches pair DITHER_TWIN with DITHER_PN2 of the same variant; every dither row has its own batch-1 prefill.
h_ref and the captured S/R states stay in fp32 exactly as in exp19's TaskContext (memory allowed it); the plan's bf16 storage was only a memory saving.

The W16A16 anchor uses the factorial's own W16A16 TWIN rows (T10, W1-W5 k0-4) against exp27's TWIN rows. exp27 generated them on its left-padded mixed-prompt batch path, so byte identity is not expected; label agreement >= 0.9 is the criterion.
Staged scaling 10 -> 100 -> full rows is replaced by per-batch timing with a continuous time extrapolation inside the queue (every batch is a fixed 20-row unit).

The first generation runner (deadline 150 min, estimate = median of the last 20 batches) dropped prio 2-6 (dither ii, dither i, unit cross, T03 middle precisions, POP middle k1) at 20:51-20:53Z, after T2's slow population batches. The drops were time-only, but the estimate was mis-specified, so the runner was stopped at 21:05Z and restarted (resumable) with a 145-min deadline, a mean-of-all-batches estimate and the REAL extras beyond the plan (REAL T03 and REAL population cells) first in the drop order. src/run_e.py was re-committed (commit1b). No row was discarded and no analysis code changed. A relaunch at 21:00Z failed with OOM because the orphaned first runner still held the GPU; it wrote stale gen_done/readouts_done flags, which were removed.

The prompt diff compares exp19's twin prompts with exp27's prompt file (the iteration-5 bf16 engine). exp25's extra arm A prompt file was not copied; its reference shares come from inputs/exp25/results/extra_arm_a.json and exp27 cells.json.
The token cap is 1,024 for every task including T2 (exp19's MAX_NEW_PATH deviation), so exp19's slots can be reproduced.

The iteration-5 ban-free unit per [l,p] is not stored by exp27 (only unit_ratio.json); the unit table uses that ratio, and this artifact's own ban-free units (results/unit_banfree_<task>_<precision>.npy) are computed from each precision's clean twins x r_Q.
